item.title: Preschool funding changes face scrutiny as not-for-profits warn of cutsents take shape
item.description: Member for Cootamundra Steph Cooke has asked the NSW Government to explain how preschool funding changes will affect regional and rural community preschools. She lodged a question on notice in the Legislative Assembly on 10 November, seeking financial modelling, consultation details and safeguards for services facing reductions.

item.title: First Nations languages in early learning: starting with people, not a word list
item.description: When considering introducing local First Nations language into your early learning program, knowing where to begin can feel uncertain. Community Early Learning Australia’s (CELA) guidance explores how educators can approach this respectfully, starting with relationships, permission and advice from the community whose language they hope to share.

item.title: Teachers are being prepared to enter the profession. But are they being prepared to stay?
item.description: Teachers are being prepared to enter the teaching profession however they may not be being adequately prepared to stay in the profession. A new report by the University of Melbourne highlights that teachers’ well-being is one of the biggest factors influencing their staying power. However, it is not currently being taught as a part of teacher training programs. Future teachers are expected to manage increasingly complex classrooms, student mental health, family relationships and increased worklo
